name: LostCities - 1.20-7.5.6
changelog:
## LostCities 1.20-7.5.6
- Kept active chunk and highway planning work pinned during cache eviction, and bounded completed highway-planning futures to prevent duplicate work and long-session cache growth
- Forced-building spawn searches now reject impossible city chunks and city styles before full building planning, reducing new-world spawn delays. Experimentally, this cuts down on about 40% of the overall time and 99% of the queried chunks. The main bottleneck is still highway planning for the remaining chunks.
- Inter-city highway planning now schedules only hubs reached by route and reciprocal-neighbour dependencies across workers, avoiding fixed-area prewarming and synchronous cold hub scans during route selection
- Inter-city highway planning now skips terrain samples that cannot qualify as a hub, reducing work when exploring new areas. Experimentally, this cuts down on about 80% of the world height queries when generating highway hubs.
- Terrain height sampling no longer blocks all world-generation workers on a single lock, so chunks in different areas generate in parallel instead of queueing behind each other
- Chunk planning is now tracked per chunk instead of per dimension, so a chunk that has to plan a large inter-city highway network no longer stalls generation everywhere else in the world
- Inter-city highway planning now reuses the shared city-level cache instead of recalculating terrain heights for every hub it samples
- Inter-city highway hubs and routes are now planned across several threads instead of one, so the first chunk to reach a new part of the network is generated much faster

name: LostCities - 1.20-7.5.5
changelog:
## LostCities 1.20-7.5.5
- Exposed the current chunk's city style through the API, including outside cities, so integrations can match styles away from city centers
- Fixed overlapping terrain-height samples near coordinate axes that could break multibuilding generation, and made size-2 sampling deterministic; floor-selection errors now identify the failing building and floor
- Made steep terrain-to-city transitions less regular and removed floating vines left by terrain correction or invalid supports
- Added world- and city-style bridge support settings and world-style highway support settings, including reusable vertical support parts while preserving legacy part metadata
- Fixed numeric profile fields replacing temporary input while typing multi-digit values
- Added separate north-south and east-west railway spacing profile options, with safe surface-station slopes and highway avoidance
- Removed code that tried to clean up blocks above smaller explosions as that could lead to weird chunk-sized gaps. Especially in highways
- Avoided villages and structures now keep a terrain-transition ring when flattening is disabled, preventing sharp chunk-edge cliffs next to cities

name: LostCities - 1.20-7.5.0
changelog:
## LostCities 1.20-7.5.0
- Hierarchical streets:
####     - Added versioned hierarchical street generation with primary, secondary, and tertiary roads, wider primary roads, slopes, connectors, and deterministic large bridges. Existing worlds keep legacy street generation
####     - Added an optional city-style `tertiaryparts` street asset family, defaulting to the secondary-road `parts` family
####     - Added a separate `openLotParkChance` profile option, defaulting to 0.8, so hierarchical open lots use varied park parts more often without changing legacy park frequency
- Inter-city highways:
####     - Added a versioned inter-city highway network which creates deterministic routes between likely city regions, with endpoint-based or fixed highway levels. Existing worlds keep legacy highway generation
####     - Added dedicated highway bend and T-junction parts
####     - Added highway-side gas stations and two-chunk restaurants with parking lots, automatic highway-facing rotation, matching deck heights, and configurable foundation supports
####     - Fixed rotated restaurant doors, opened highway railing for restaurant and gas-station access, and added two-high restaurant perimeter railings
- Buildings and structure avoidance:
####     - Structure avoidance now treats each multibuilding as a single footprint, so it is either generated completely or avoided completely
####     - Fixed scattered multibuildings sometimes generating only partially. Their complete placement and validity are now decided once for the entire scattered area
####     - Fixed bugs in blacklisted-structure checks that could miss structures or fail on structure references without registry keys
- Performance and stability:
####     - Improved performance when searching for forced building spawn locations
####     - Reworked world generation for safe multithreading. Non-overlapping chunks and different dimensions can generate concurrently while nearby chunks and lifecycle cleanup remain protected
- Assets, tools, and documentation:
####     - City styles can now override hierarchical open-lot park frequency with `profile_overrides.openLotParkChance`, independently from legacy park chance
####     - Added `forcedair` part metadata for hard-air cells
####     - The `/lostcities debug` command now reports the containing multibuilding name
####     - Added practical profile customization examples and developer documentation for custom assets, city generation, and world-generation thread safety

name: LostCities - 1.20-7.4.0
changelog:
LostCities 1.20-7.4.0


   - New 'railpartheight6' setting for worldstyle that indicates how high railway parts can be (in multiples of 6)
   - New 'optimizedHeightmap' config option to use a more optimized way to calculate the heightmap. This is disabled by default
   - New 'heightSampleSize' config option to control the size of the heightmap sample. This is used to calculate the heightmap for cities. By default this is 1 which means every chunk
   - TqLxQuanZ changed how park generation works, now there's a config to determine if park should spawn when the neighbouring street must more than a certain amount.
   - TqLxQuanZ added optional building floors override Profile/Citystyle floor settings. (Use "overrideFloors": true in building definition)
   - TqLxQuanZ added ParkChance/FountainChance/AvoidFoliage/ParkBorder/ParkElevation/CorridorChance/ParkStreetThreshold support for CityStyle override. Meaning each city style can have different chance now and settings on those now!
   - TqLxQuanZ fixed ParkChance not working at all, it scales with total neighbour street condition + current chunk's park chance.
   - TqLxQuanZ cleaned up unused/outdated profile settings.
   - TqLxQuanZ added four new city levels
   - TqLxQuanZ added an option to use multibuilding top left corner level instead of average level for multibuildings
   - Improved the flattening algorithm

name: LostCities - 1.20-7.3.6
changelog:
LostCities 1.20-7.3.6


   - New 'avoidVillages' config to avoid generating Lost Cities in chunks that have villages. Default set to true
   - New 'biosphere_caves' landscape type and profile to combine a cavern type world with spheres (for usage with Lost Worlds)
   - Fixed city level calculations for the new 'cavespheres' landscape type
   - Fixed a problem where some type of station could override multibuilding chunks
   - Chances of scattered buildings were reversed. A chance of 0 would make it generate all the time. Warning! This will change how rare scattered buildings are! You might want to adjust your world style for this
   - Added new 'scatteredChanceMultiplier' profile option to control the chance of scattered buildings. This value is multiplied with the normal chance
   - The new 'scatteredChanceMultiplier' profile option can now also be set from the in-game Lost City configuration screen
   - Scattered building placement checking is now more accurate. Mostly with regards to the 'maxheightdiff' option which now actually works for single chunk buildings
   - It is no longer required to specify fountains, parks, front types, rail dungeons, or stairs in the city style. If they are missing then no fountains or parks will be generated
   - The 'inpart', 'inbuilding', and 'inbiome' conditions for parts, spawners, ... now support lists in addition to a single value
   - New 'belowpart' condition which checks if the floor below this one is a certain part. This can be used to make sure that a certain part only generates on top of another part. This also supports lists
   - Problem with scattered parts with multiple floors where the height for the subsequent floors was not correctly calculated
